retained.core: All 136 pinned Bootstrap-derived modules, including the six approved SEC-001/A11Y-001 patched modules.
retained.optional: Non-legacy extensions, adapters, icons, and themes remain isolated from the default core.
retained.fixtures: Root examples and remaining hybrid-era tests are test-migration inputs, not a fallback implementation or published documentation examples. Their modernization remains an explicit acceptance task.
retained.evidence: Historical non-executable audit reports and upstream reference caches are retained as evidence, not runtime alternatives.

recovery: External source archive, outside the project and npm package; see artifacts/legacy-removal-report.json. Generated copies are reproducible rather than separately archived.
